title: British Parliamentary debate — four-coalition non-comparable draft

applicability.notes: This models the four-team chamber topology. A separate single-team benchmark would instead use two agents and scripted opponents.

required_roles.title: Opening Government prime minister
duties: Define the motion and deliver the opening government case.

required_roles.title: Opening Government deputy
duties: Defend and extend the opening government case.

required_roles.title: Opening Opposition leader
duties: Oppose the motion and answer the opening government case.

required_roles.title: Opening Opposition deputy
duties: Defend and extend the opening opposition case.

required_roles.title: Closing Government member
duties: Provide a distinct government extension without contradicting the opening team.

required_roles.title: Closing Government whip
duties: Compare the debate and crystallize the government bench's winning material.

required_roles.title: Closing Opposition member
duties: Provide a distinct opposition extension without contradicting the opening team.

required_roles.title: Closing Opposition whip
duties: Compare the debate and crystallize the opposition bench's winning material.

turn_budget.derivation: Speech order and preparation are represented by turns; official speech and protected-time clocks are not reproduced.

state_requirements.description: Eight speeches occur in official BP order with separate speaking clocks.
Opposing speakers may offer points of information during unprotected time.
Judges rank all four teams first through fourth without ties.

constraints.statement: A British Parliamentary debate contains four separate teams of two speakers.
Each two-person team prepares privately and may not collaborate with the other three teams.
Generative AI may not be used during preparation or debate.
constraints.waiver_reason: All eight simulated speakers are LLM agents.

collaboration.notes: Only partners share private preparation; speeches become public chamber information in official order.

submission.adaptation: Oratory, POIs, protected time, and live delivery are flattened into text.

evaluation.notes: A valid evaluator must rank four teams and account for role fulfillment, extensions, engagement, and delivery.

waivers.benchmark_treatment: All speakers are generative AI agents.

sources.title: WUDC Manual 2025
sources.locator: Team structure, preparation, speaker order, POIs, and adjudication

provenance.notes: This corrects the current card's treatment of eight opponents as one cooperative team.
